title: Using a coupon at checkout
summary: Each coupon can be used once per customer account, not once per device.
steps: Apply the coupon in your cart.
sees: The discount is applied to your cart.
If your account already used the coupon, on any device, no discount is applied and you see “This coupon was already used on your account.”
If you are not signed in, the coupon is not applied and you are asked to sign in.
notes: Guests without an account cannot use coupons.
